messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Add dynamic column to datatable
parts:
Hi Henrique,
This is more of a shiny question than a shinyapps question. Moving to that discussion list.
-Tareef

On Fri, Dec 11, 2015 at 5:44 AM, Henrique Cabral <cabralh...@gmail.com> wrote:
I would like to add a dynamic column that is calculated from another column in the datatable. Specifically, I would like the new column to show the cumulative sum from an existing column..
Looking into the datatable column options (http://legacy.datatables.net/usage/columns), I think that would be possible, but I wasn't able of implementing in my own code.
Here's a minimalistic example of what I would like to achieve:

# ----------- ui.R:
library(shiny)
library(DT)

shinyUI(fluidPage(sidebarLayout(
            sidebarPanel(), mainPanel(DT::dataTableOutput('my_table'))
)))

# ----------- server.R
library(DT)

# Define server logic
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    my_table <- data.frame(x = seq(10),y = rnorm(10))

    output$my_table <- DT::renderDataTable({
            DT::datatable(
            my_table,
            options = list(aoColumnDefs = 
        list(mData = 'new_column',
                                                             mRender = JS('function(data, type, row){
           return CALCULATE CUMULATIVE SUM;
           }')
        ))
            )})
})
